interpretation: Design contracts for 46 proposed application commands. These are not installed JCB endpoints, runnable code, a native import, or proof of behaviour. Implement through native JCB definitions/Powers after M01 proves owner loading, same connection and rollback.

rules: Declare each action explicitly in generated Joomla access definitions; no wildcard dispatch permission.
Derive actor and organisation from authenticated context; authorise action, farm, enterprise, related records and private evidence before access and again on replay.
Owner service entry points enforce the same policies as UI and API. Never accept client actor, role, approved totals, functional values or bypass flags.

payload_contract.types: UUID references resolve within the same organisation and authorised scope. Decimal amounts and quantities are canonical decimal strings; integer counts remain integers. business_date is YYYY-MM-DD; utc_timestamp includes UTC offset; local times use the property timezone.
payload_contract.unknown_fields: Reject unknown fields after resolving the command-specific payload schema. Shared shapes below define logical fields, not generated endpoint bindings.
payload_contract.create: aggregate_mode=create requires no existing aggregate GUID/version; server assigns identity. Existing commands require aggregate_guid and expected_version. Existing_or_create must specify one branch in its final strict native schema.
payload_contract.evidence: Every evidence_file_guid is an authorised Core file/document_link of the accepted purpose and status; a string URL never substitutes for private evidence.
payload_contract.dates: occurred_on preserves business occurrence. Server chooses permitted posting date according to period/cost-order rules; no caller-controlled historic valuation insertion.

required_native_proof: Native JCB definition round trip and regeneration
Same database connection and single outer transaction across owners
Denied action and scope through direct model, generated CRUD and API routes
Rollback, replay, changed payload and duplicate natural-source cases
preconditions: Strict envelope and payload validation; current action and scope authorised.
Existing aggregate is at expected_version; all related owner records and evidence are visible and valid.
All writes use owner services in one outer transaction; no inner commit or HTTP call between components.

locks.reason: Unique receipt serialises replay; changed actor/hash is a conflict.

effects.change: Persist final safe result and immutable effect GUIDs with the same commit.

common_command_contract.idempotency: Unique (organisation_guid,command_type,request_key); hash canonical command, payload, scope, expected_version and authenticated actor. Same hash returns committed result after current authorisation; changed hash conflicts. Source uniqueness survives receipt retention. Failed transaction leaves no business effects; uncertain response retries original key.
common_command_contract.failure: Any failed precondition or owner effect rolls back every business write, number allocation, receipt success and outbox insert. Return a specific conflict/validation/authorisation result; no success body on failure.
common_command_contract.natural_source_persistence: A declared source-uniqueness key must be enforced by a database constraint on authoritative owner records or Core external_reference. For unmodelled external event/completion keys, use a fixed command-specific provider namespace and stable normalised identity; external_reference links the committed command receipt/effect set and is retained with source history. An audit message or application-only lookup is insufficient.

lock_protocol.mode: FOR UPDATE or proven equivalent on the supported transactional engine
lock_protocol.ordering: Plan the full set before writes; deduplicate and sort by rank, owner_component, entity and canonical key. Do not acquire a lower-rank lock after a higher-rank lock. If discovery changes the required set, restart with a complete plan.

ranks.30: business aggregates, identity and configuration parents

lock_protocol.missing_rows: Lock an existing stable parent before checking/inserting an absent child, then rely on unique constraints. Canonical non-null balance_key includes explicit sentinels for absent lot/bin/ownership dimensions.
lock_protocol.inventory: All stock and hold writers share product/warehouse/lot guards; valuation locks the same product+warehouse pool. Existing Core product plus Ledger warehouse parents cover absent pool/balance/lot rows.
lock_protocol.capacity: Lock existing Stay resource parent rows sorted by GUID before all slot/night claims; aliases resolve to the same physical resource. Do not assume a capacity table, exclusion index, partial index or predicate lock exists.
lock_protocol.periods: Native financial posting and close use the same period row guard. Recheck open state under lock; operational/export mode has no native GL posting.

rules: Ledger derives actual disposition, output, date and source from the approved owner record; a client cannot label a sale as a harmless transfer.

Evaluate every effective stock_hold under the common inventory guards. Overlapping holds apply to the union of affected physical units, never twice; unidentifiable overlapping partial holds conservatively block the ambiguous units.

Resolve individually tracked animal lots and restricted group ancestry; call Livestock policy for each affected meat, milk, live movement or configured output restriction independently. Missing required owner policy fails closed.
Group splits, transfers and individualisation preserve restriction provenance and inherit all applicable intervals; removing a group membership or changing an identifier never clears restrictions.
Crop harvest/input restrictions and Make quality/recall holds remain enforced through Ledger direct paths; summary quality_state or withdrawal_ends_at is not authority.
Reservation is not a release certificate; re-evaluate eligibility at issue, transfer, production consumption and correction. Incoming/reversed stock retains applicable restrictions.
Generic CRUD, imports and API saves cannot mutate posted stock, quality or restriction status; no bypass/override flag.
mandatory_stock_eligibility.locking: Discover all affected domain parents and restriction ancestry before taking inventory locks. Animal/group and crop-cycle/plot parent locks precede product/warehouse/lot locks. Every restriction writer uses these same parent guards; absent/new restriction rows cannot evade a concurrent eligibility check. Acquire all source parents and selected restrictions in canonical order; if discovery changes the closure, roll back and replan.
